summary: FD_TC_060_No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (fallback: departure delay code 73, weather en route or at alternate), APPR
title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (fallback: departure delay code 73, weather en route or at alternate), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours. There's no cancellation code and no arrival delay code, so the rules engine falls back to the first departure delay code, 73 (severe thunderstorms along the YUL?YYZ route, uncontrollable). The customer chooses not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that the fallback path is used, that No Travel Origin plus an uncontrollable fallback code returns Not Eligible under APPR (FD-APPR-NE-09), and that the customer is entitled to a full ticket refund.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC048: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. Arrival delay code: NOT AVAILABLE (null/empty). First departure delay code 73 (WR). Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
